Shoulder seams hanging a touch too low... hems of the arm a span too short. Much work to be done, this one. So, what would you like to have altered?
……有些落肩，袖子似乎短了一拃。嗯，是位需要大改的客人啊。你们是来改什么的？

We would like to procure a pair of scissors.
……我们想询问是否可以购买剪刀。

... My scissors are not tools to be hung and sold from the product racks. I do not part with my blades for just anyone, you see.
……我的剪刀不是挂在展台上出售的物品。可没法轻易地交给其他人。

They're reserved for customers whose eyes twinkle with the desire to go snip-snip. Like the Noirs, my longtime customers—they always visit me to have me weave fabric for them. 我只会将其交给有着想要剪碎什么的眼神的客人。比如黑派那些长期找我做面料的客人。

Are you... well-acquainted with the Noirs?
黑派……你与他们很熟悉吗？

I've been supplying them with fabric for a while now, so one could say that we are partners.
可以说是协助关系吧。我会定期给他们制作和供给面料。

The Noirs have been quite busy as of late—spreading and fishing tales, suspicious that the red ones are up to no good.
他们似乎最近格外地忙碌。说什么红色的家伙们行为可疑，在不断散布和收集传闻呢。

I simply do not see that same passionate desire in you. I do have other items available for purchase, however.
但从你们身上看不到那种热切的期望。不过，我还有其他东西可供购买。

<Looks like getting straight to the point won't work on her... This isn't what happened last time.>
<看来是因为直接去问了剪刀的事，发展和之前不一样了……>

Perhaps... we could procure the pair of scissors at our next opportunity, Manager.
等到……下次机会再来获取剪刀吧，如何。

<Don't think we have any other choice.>
<就这样吧。>

So... why did we need a pair of scissors, again?
我们……为什么会需要剪刀呢？

Scissors, when honed to perfection, can be excellent weapons. It is obviously in preparation for the coming war.
若是制作方法不同，剪刀也能成为强大的武器。执行经理可是全都考量到了。
